_doc: Slide-2 exec-summary / thesis. DISTILLED from the partner proposal; proposal is source of truth.
thesis: Ocean Whisperer already owns whisper-quiet, four-guest, aviation-grade calm in the air. The water layer is still diesel — and off-brand.
the_deal: We extend the same ultra-premium standard from Hato to Baoase and Sandals Royal Curaçao — silent foiling transfers, cruise-pier feeds, and resort-to-resort hops on sealed leeward geometry. Navier supplies the fleet and certification path; Ocean Whisperer brings the brand, resort relationships, and government/port access.

your_world.label: Where you are today
your_world.text: Ocean Whisperer flies the MD 520N NOTAR helicopter — four guests, private arrangement, curated signature journeys across Curaçao's resort coast.

your_world.label: What you're up against
your_world.text: Guest mobility on the surface is still loud diesel shuttles — airport to resort, pier to beach club, resort to resort — the weakest link in an aviation-luxury brand.

your_world.label: Where Navier fits
your_world.text: The marine extension of the brand you already operate: whisper-quiet foiling, four-guest curated runs, aviation-grade reliability from air gateway to resort jetty.

your_world.label: Why now
your_world.text: March 2026 air launch is live; Curaçao is pushing high-value low-impact tourism as reef wake rules tighten — the water tier arrives exactly when the brand is ready to standardize air-to-water.
